issues.description: The problem statement and solution refer to a function named simulate_msd_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float) but the template defines a differently named function simulate_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float). Additionally, the template's plot_msd calls simulate_msd_one_round (which does not exist in the template), causing a mismatch that will lead to NameError or failing tests. This is a structural signature/name mismatch that will prevent students from running or testing the provided template as-is and will confuse them about the expected function name to implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template's function name match the specification and solution. Rename simulate_one_round to simulate_msd_one_round, or add a wrapper simulate_msd_one_round that calls simulate_one_round. Also ensure plot_msd (and any other callers) reference the same function name. This keeps the template consistent with the problem statement and the solution reference implementation.
